body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0015 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Branch protection or ruleset weakened on default branch - protected_branch / repository_ruleset destroy or weaken"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0015"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1685.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "protected_branch.destroy" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "protected_branch.update_allow_force_pushes" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repository_ruleset.destroy" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repository_ruleset.update" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
